description.value: A 24/7 McDonald's franchise on Main Street in Penticton offering burgers, McCafé beverages, and a full breakfast menu. The location operates Drive-Thru, Curbside, and McDelivery services, making it a quick stop for cyclists needing a fast refuel. As a large chain restaurant, it is one of the more accessible food options along the Penticton corridor.
